tape-delay.name: Tape Delay
tape-delay.shortDesc: Warm analog tape echo with flutter and high-frequency roll-off.
tape-delay.description: Tape echo model: wow and flutter on the delay time, saturated repeats, and a dark, band-limited feedback path. Past ~85% the Feedback knob pushes the loop into self-oscillation like a real tape echo.

dattorro-plate.name: Dattorro Plate Reverb
dattorro-plate.shortDesc: Rich spatial diffusion based on the legendary Dattorro plate topology.
dattorro-plate.description: True Dattorro plate topology: input diffusion allpasses feeding a figure-eight tank of cross-coupled delay lines with damping. Decay runs from a tight 0.2 s slap to a 25 s wash.

bbd-chorus.name: BBD Stereo Chorus
bbd-chorus.shortDesc: Lush bucket-brigade analog chorus and pitch vibrato.
bbd-chorus.description: Recreates the warm, dimensional swirl of dual bucket-brigade delay lines with anti-phase sinusoidal LFO modulation.

harmonic-tremolo.name: Harmonic Tremolo
harmonic-tremolo.description: Splits the signal into high-pass and low-pass crossover bands, modulating them 180 degrees out of phase for a hypnotic, Doppler-like pulse.

dynamic-overdrive.name: Dynamic Overdrive
dynamic-overdrive.shortDesc: Asymmetric soft-clipping tube-style drive with pick dynamics.
dynamic-overdrive.description: Touch-sensitive tube saturation utilizing polynomial hyperbolic tangent waveshaping, pre-emphasis mid-boost, and post-drive cabinet smoothing.

klon-centaur.name: Klon Centaur
klon-centaur.shortDesc: Full circuit model of the Klon Centaur: transparent, touch-sensitive overdrive.
klon-centaur.description: Wave-digital-filter model of the real Centaur circuit (gain pot, germanium diode clipper, tone network) from the Faust standard library (ve.klonCentaur, Jatin Chowdhury's ChowCentaur port) — BSD licensed, so it ships cleanly. Chameleon only wraps it with three knobs.

infinite-compressor.name: Infinite Sustain Compressor
infinite-compressor.shortDesc: High-ratio leveling amplifier for endless singing sustain.
infinite-compressor.description: Squashes harsh picking spikes and continuously ramps up automatic makeup gain as notes fade, holding guitar sustain flat for 15+ seconds.

multi-phaser.name: Multi-Stage Phaser
multi-phaser.shortDesc: Cascaded all-pass phase shifter with feedback.
multi-phaser.description: Generates shifting spectral notches across 4 to 8 allpass filter stages. Moves smoothly from vintage Phase 90 sweeps to chewy, resonant vortexes.

silicon-fuzz.name: Silicon Fuzz & Wavefolder
silicon-fuzz.shortDesc: Hard-clipping gated fuzz with wavefolding bite.
silicon-fuzz.description: High-gain silicon fuzz with a bias control that shifts the clipping symmetry (even harmonics) and starves quiet signals through a gate, plus a touch of wavefolding on the peaks.

auto-wah.name: Auto-Wah / Envelope Filter
auto-wah.shortDesc: Dynamic resonant band-pass filter tracking pick attack.
auto-wah.description: Vintage Q-Tron envelope follower that tracks your picking velocity to sweep a resonant 2nd-order state-variable bandpass filter.

pitch-octaver.name: Dual Pitch Octaver
pitch-octaver.shortDesc: Polyphonic sub-octave and upper octave harmonic generator.
pitch-octaver.description: Creates thick multi-octave guitar sounds with clean tracking. Generates a deep -1 octave sub tone and a shimmering +1 octave upper tone.

analog-flanger.name: Jet Flanger
analog-flanger.shortDesc: Resonant comb filter with jet-plane through-zero sweep.
analog-flanger.description: Short modulated delay lines coupled with aggressive inverted feedback create massive comb filter hollow sweeps and jet airplane passes.

spring-reverb.name: Spring Reverb Tank
spring-reverb.shortDesc: Physical model of dual-spring mechanical reverb bounce.
spring-reverb.description: Spring tank model: a drive stage into a chain of dispersive allpass sections (the "boing") feeding two spring lines of different lengths with dark feedback.

clean-boost.name: JFET Preamp Boost
clean-boost.shortDesc: Discrete Class-A JFET boost with tilt-EQ saturation.
clean-boost.description: Pushes tube amp front ends into natural breakup while adding harmonic sheen. Center knob tilts between low-end fatness and treble sparkle.

reverse-delay.name: Reverse Delay
reverse-delay.shortDesc: Backwards buffer playback for psychedelic textures.
reverse-delay.description: Two backwards-running read heads half a window apart, crossfaded so the reversed audio has no seams, with a filtered feedback path.

lofi-bitcrush.name: Lo-Fi Bitcrusher
lofi-bitcrush.shortDesc: Sample rate decimation and dynamic bit reduction.
lofi-bitcrush.description: Sample-and-hold decimation at the target rate plus bit-depth quantisation, blended against the dry signal.

drum-pumping-comp.name: Pumping VCA Drum Compressor
drum-pumping-comp.shortDesc: Aggressive sidechain-style pumping compressor for dance beats.
drum-pumping-comp.description: Designed specifically for analog drum machines. Clamps down heavily on kick transients and breathes out with exaggerated, musical pumping.

gated-snare-reverb.name: 80s Gated Snare Reverb
gated-snare-reverb.shortDesc: Explosive non-linear gated reverb tail that cuts off abruptly.
gated-snare-reverb.description: Big room (Freeverb) keyed from the kick/snare band of the dry input; the gate slams shut a set hold time after each hit.

resonant-dj-filter.name: Resonant DJ Dual Filter
resonant-dj-filter.shortDesc: High-resonance Low-Pass (turn left) and High-Pass (turn right) sweep.
resonant-dj-filter.description: One knob, centre is clean: sweep left for a resonant low-pass down to 60 Hz, right for a resonant high-pass up to 8 kHz. Exponential sweep, analog-style saturation at high resonance.

tape-saturation-drum.name: Analog Tape Saturator
tape-saturation-drum.shortDesc: Fat analog tape drive that glues kicks and rounds harsh cymbals.
tape-saturation-drum.description: Harmonic saturation tuned for analog drum machines. Tames piercing metallic cymbals on the DrumBrute/Volca and fattens low-end kick body.

beat-repeater.name: Beat Repeater / Stutter
beat-repeater.shortDesc: Buffer stutter: grabs a slice and repeats it N times in tempo-sized subdivisions.
beat-repeater.description: Captures a slice of the incoming beat and plays it back N times before grabbing a fresh one. Short slices give glitchy rolls; long slices give bar-level loops.

sub-resonator.name: 808 Sub-Bass Resonator
sub-resonator.shortDesc: Triggers a massive 40-60Hz sine boom on drum transients.
sub-resonator.description: A tuned 2-pole resonator excited only by the low band of the input, with Q derived from the Decay knob so the boom rings for the time you set.

drum-slammer.name: Drum Slammer Peak Limiter
drum-slammer.shortDesc: Brickwall peak limiter maximizing perceived drum loudness.
drum-slammer.description: Over-the-top peak limiter and clipper. Crushes drum dynamics to create that explosive, in-your-face room sound without digital overs.

ring-mod-percussion.name: Metallic Ring Modulator
ring-mod-percussion.shortDesc: Frequency multiplication for robotic, metallic drum timbres.
ring-mod-percussion.description: Multiplies drum hits with a carrier sine/square wave to create clanging cowbells, futuristic laser toms, and dissonant industrial hi-hats.

transient-shaper.name: Drum Transient Shaper
transient-shaper.shortDesc: Independent attack click boost and sustain body control.
transient-shaper.description: Compares a fast and a slow envelope follower; attacks are boosted or cut where the fast envelope leads, sustain where it lags.

stereo-pingpong-beat.name: Multi-Tap Beat Delay
stereo-pingpong-beat.shortDesc: Rhythmic straight + dotted-eighth two-tap delay with filtered feedback.
stereo-pingpong-beat.description: Two rhythmic taps (straight and dotted) with a dark filtered feedback path. The pedal has one output jack, so this replaces the stereo ping-pong idea with a mono multi-tap pattern that gives the same syncopation.

wavefolder-dirt.name: Buchla Drum Wavefolder
wavefolder-dirt.shortDesc: Non-linear wavefolding for aggressive industrial drum harmonics.
wavefolder-dirt.description: Instead of clipping waveforms, wavefolders fold high-level peaks backwards towards zero, turning simple analog kicks into aggressive techno monsters.

comb-resonator.name: Comb Filter Resonator
comb-resonator.shortDesc: Pitched resonant comb filter turning drum bursts into synth notes.
comb-resonator.description: Highly tuned feedback comb filter that rings at precise musical pitches when excited by noisy snare cracks or sharp rimshots.

freq-shifter.name: Bode Frequency Shifter
freq-shifter.shortDesc: Linear frequency shifting for dissonant alien percussion.
freq-shifter.description: Single-sideband frequency shifter built on a Hilbert allpass pair: every partial moves by the same number of Hz, wrecking harmonic relationships for bell-like, inharmonic percussion.

bbd-drum-delay.name: Dark BBD Percussion Delay
bbd-drum-delay.shortDesc: Dark, saturated analog bucket-brigade delay for drums.
bbd-drum-delay.description: Filtered repeats that sit neatly behind drum grooves without cluttering the mix. Features progressive high-cut filtering on successive echoes.

expander-gate.name: Drum Expander / Noise Gate
expander-gate.shortDesc: Fast downward expander cutting background hiss and hum.
expander-gate.description: Downward expander with a 4:1 slope below threshold and a range control so hiss can be reduced rather than hard-muted.
